te: Battle of Fleurus marks the first successful military use of aircraft and turns the tide of the War of the First Coalit…
dz: 法国革命战争：弗勒鲁斯战役标志着飞机的首次成功军事使用，并扭转了第一次反法同盟战争的局势。
de: French Revolutionary Wars: Battle of Fleurus marks the first successful military use of aircraft and turns the tide of the War of the First Coalition.

t: 一支由西班牙人,自由黑人和同盟军印第安人所组成的联合部队在詹金斯耳战争中在圣奥古斯丁附近的摩斯…
te: A combined force of Spanish, free blacks and allied Indians defeat a British garrison at the Siege of Fort Mose near St…
dz: 一支由西班牙人,自由黑人和同盟军印第安人所组成的联合部队在詹金斯耳战争中在圣奥古斯丁附近的摩斯堡(英语:Siege of Mose)击败了一支英国驻军.
de: A combined force of Spanish, free blacks and allied Indians defeat a British garrison at the Siege of Fort Mose near St. Augustine during the War of Jenkins' Ear.

t: 在被大炮包围和轰炸后,巴库向俄国人投降.
te: After a siege and bombardment by cannon, Baku surrenders to the Russians.
dz: 在被大炮包围和轰炸后,巴库向俄国人投降.
de: After a siege and bombardment by cannon, Baku surrenders to the Russians.

t: 俄罗斯皇太子阿列克谢·彼得罗维奇因被指控密谋反对其父彼得大帝，被父亲判处死刑后离奇身亡。
te: Alexei Petrovich, Tsarevich of Russia, Peter the Great's son, mysteriously dies after being sentenced to death by his f…
dz: 俄罗斯皇太子阿列克谢·彼得罗维奇因被指控密谋反对其父彼得大帝，被父亲判处死刑后离奇身亡。
de: Alexei Petrovich, Tsarevich of Russia, Peter the Great's son, mysteriously dies after being sentenced to death by his father for plotting against him.

t: 一支加入的Hitaller-Venetian舰队在达尔达内勒斯战役中击败了数量上优越的奥斯曼舰…
te: A joined Hospitaller-Venetian fleet defeats a numerically superior Ottoman fleet in the battle of the Dardanelles.
dz: 一支加入的Hitaller-Venetian舰队在达尔达内勒斯战役中击败了数量上优越的奥斯曼舰队.
de: A joined Hospitaller-Venetian fleet defeats a numerically superior Ottoman fleet in the battle of the Dardanelles.

t: 斯蒂芬·巴托里(Stephen Báthory)的利沃尼亚运动开始.
te: Livonian campaign of Stephen Báthory begins.
dz: 斯蒂芬·巴托里(Stephen Báthory)的利沃尼亚运动开始.
de: Livonian campaign of Stephen Báthory begins.

t: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗在利马被他的前同伴、后来的对手、小迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗的儿子暗杀。阿尔马格罗…
te: Francisco Pizarro is assassinated in Lima by the son of his former companion and later antagonist, Diego de Almagro the…
dz: 弗朗西斯科·皮萨罗在利马被他的前同伴、后来的对手、小迭戈·德·阿尔马格罗的儿子暗杀。阿尔马格罗后来被捕并被处决。
de: Francisco Pizarro is assassinated in Lima by the son of his former companion and later antagonist, Diego de Almagro the younger. Almagro is later caught and executed.

t: 舍尔·沙阿·苏里手下的阿富汗苏尔部队在绍萨之战中击败了胡马云手下的莫卧儿军队.
te: Afghan Sur forces under Sher Shah Suri defeat a Mughal army under Humayun in the battle of Chausa.
dz: 舍尔·沙阿·苏里手下的阿富汗苏尔部队在绍萨之战中击败了胡马云手下的莫卧儿军队.
de: Afghan Sur forces under Sher Shah Suri defeat a Mughal army under Humayun in the battle of Chausa.

t: 奥斯曼人开始第二次围攻罗得斯.
te: Ottomans begin the second Siege of Rhodes.
dz: 奥斯曼人开始第二次围攻罗得斯.
de: Ottomans begin the second Siege of Rhodes.

t: 理查三世成为了英格兰国王.
te: Richard III becomes King of England.
dz: 理查三世成为了英格兰国王.
de: Richard III becomes King of England.

t: 第十六代沃里克伯爵理查德·内维尔和马奇伯爵爱德华率领叛军登陆英格兰并向伦敦进军。
te: Richard Neville, 16th Earl of Warwick, and Edward, Earl of March, land in England with a rebel army and march on London.
dz: 玫瑰战争：第十六代沃里克伯爵理查德·内维尔和马奇伯爵爱德华率领叛军登陆英格兰并向伦敦进军。
de: War of the Roses: Richard Neville, 16th Earl of Warwick, and Edward, Earl of March, land in England with a rebel army and march on London.

t: 罗马天主教会被引入了双层分裂,因为彼得罗斯·菲拉尔戈斯被比萨理事会后加冕为教宗亚历山大五世,在…
te: The Roman Catholic Church is led into a double schism as Petros Philargos is crowned Pope Alexander V after the Council…
dz: 西施主义:罗马天主教会被引入了双层分裂,因为彼得罗斯·菲拉尔戈斯被比萨理事会后加冕为教宗亚历山大五世,在罗马加入教宗格里高利十二世和阿维尼翁加入教宗本笃十三世.
de: Western Schism: The Roman Catholic Church is led into a double schism as Petros Philargos is crowned Pope Alexander V after the Council of Pisa, joining Pope Gregory XII in Rome and Pope Benedict XIII in Avignon.

t: Ulrich von Jungingen成为铁道骑士团的外公.
te: Ulrich von Jungingen becomes Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights.
dz: Ulrich von Jungingen成为铁道骑士团的外公.
de: Ulrich von Jungingen becomes Grand Master of the Teutonic Knights.

t: 普雷泽米什瓦二世继杜卡尔时期后加冕为波兰国王. 白鹰被添加到波兰的臂章上.
te: Przemysł II crowned king of Poland, following Ducal period. The white eagle is added to the Polish coat of arms.
dz: 普雷泽米什瓦二世继杜卡尔时期后加冕为波兰国王. 白鹰被添加到波兰的臂章上.
de: Przemysł II crowned king of Poland, following Ducal period. The white eagle is added to the Polish coat of arms.

t: 巴伊朱·诺扬所领导的蒙古人在克什达克之战中击败了克什克乌斯劳二世所领导的塞尔柱克突厥人. 鲁姆…
te: Mongols under Baiju Noyan defeat the Seljuk Turks under Kaykhusraw II at the Battle of Köse Dağ. The Sultanate of Rum s…
dz: 巴伊朱·诺扬所领导的蒙古人在克什达克之战中击败了克什克乌斯劳二世所领导的塞尔柱克突厥人. 鲁姆苏丹国随后成为蒙古帝国的附庸.
de: Mongols under Baiju Noyan defeat the Seljuk Turks under Kaykhusraw II at the Battle of Köse Dağ. The Sultanate of Rum subsequently becomes a vassal to the Mongol Empire.

t: 1241年教宗塞拉斯蒂内四世去世后选举教宗英诺森四世.
te: Election of Pope Innocent IV following the death of Pope Celestine IV in 1241.
dz: 1241年教宗塞拉斯蒂内四世去世后选举教宗英诺森四世.
de: Election of Pope Innocent IV following the death of Pope Celestine IV in 1241.

t: En no Ozuno，一位日本神秘主义者和药剂师，后来被视为民间宗教修验道的创始人，被流放到…
te: En no Ozuno, a Japanese mystic and apothecary who will later be regarded as the founder of the folk religion Shugendō, …
dz: En no Ozuno，一位日本神秘主义者和药剂师，后来被视为民间宗教修验道的创始人，被流放到伊豆大岛。
de: En no Ozuno, a Japanese mystic and apothecary who will later be regarded as the founder of the folk religion Shugendō, is banished to Izu Ōshima.

t: 在拜占庭皇帝的皇帝批准下,教皇本笃二世被封为教皇. 他是最后一个需要皇帝确认的教宗;下一位教宗…
te: Pope Benedict II is consecrated as pope following imperial approval from the Byzantine Emperor. He is the last pope to …
dz: 在拜占庭皇帝的皇帝批准下,教皇本笃二世被封为教皇. 他是最后一个需要皇帝确认的教宗;下一位教宗只要求位置更相近的拉文纳出任教宗.
de: Pope Benedict II is consecrated as pope following imperial approval from the Byzantine Emperor. He is the last pope to require the confirmation of the emperor; the next popes require only that of the more closely situated exarch of Ravenna.

t: 罗马皇帝朱利安被萨萨尼德部队在萨迈拉附近的一次小规模战斗中致命伤,同时从他对克特斯皮洪的围困中…
te: Roman emperor Julian is fatally wounded by Sassanid troops in a skirmish close to Samarra while retreating from his fai…
dz: 罗马皇帝朱利安被萨萨尼德部队在萨迈拉附近的一次小规模战斗中致命伤,同时从他对克特斯皮洪的围困中撤退.
de: Roman emperor Julian is fatally wounded by Sassanid troops in a skirmish close to Samarra while retreating from his failed siege of Ctesiphon.

t: 罗马皇帝埃拉加巴卢斯采纳他的堂兄亚历山大·塞维鲁斯为他的继承人并授予他凯撒的头衔.
te: Roman emperor Elagabalus adopts his cousin Alexander Severus as his heir and grants him the title of Caesar.
dz: 罗马皇帝埃拉加巴卢斯采纳他的堂兄亚历山大·塞维鲁斯为他的继承人并授予他凯撒的头衔.
de: Roman emperor Elagabalus adopts his cousin Alexander Severus as his heir and grants him the title of Caesar.

t: 奥古斯都采纳了提比略.
te: Augustus adopts Tiberius.
dz: 奥古斯都采纳了提比略.
de: Augustus adopts Tiberius.
